accuracy.internals: Bounded exact volume clipping; gameplay machinery

damageControl.basis: Included machinery service allowance: one automatic four-person work party per package with at least 400 kg declared service load, maximum eight; finite spares, powered portable pumps, repair only surviving equipment to 70%; gameplay calibration, no additional mass

loading.basis: Steel 7850 kg/m³; seawater 1025 kg/m³; internal allowance 150 kg/m³ of union envelope distributed through its lower half by height; exact convex clipping; fixed catalog service load and initial projectile stock

localDamage.basis: Fixed mass-based hull HP distributed by usable room volume; subdivision adds no HP

mountClearance.basis: Catalog gunhouses/barrels with full recoil envelope against exact hull cells and fixed equipment envelopes

ballistics.basis: Estimated linear drag from projectile mass, bore area, muzzle speed, air density 1.225 kg/m3 and Cd 0.25; penetration budget referenced at 5000 m. Shared game approximation; no historical firing-table or Mach-curve claim. See assets/parts/author-plausible-ballistics.ts.

provenance.note: Original Fletcher-derived enclosure adjusted for the approved Hsienyang Mk30 mod0 source-model proportions. Geometry is independently authored; model fit under visual review, not a historical certification.

propulsion.basis: Catalog power limited by shared funnel capacity, allocated in proportion to engine power, less 2% rated power reserved for included auxiliaries, then propeller efficiency; damaged or submerged funnels reduce shared capacity at runtime

stability.basis: Exact polyhedral buoyancy; authored loading plus low distributed internal allowance; no buoyancy calibration
